decision_rules.binding_after_search_descriptive: (i) goal-probe retention: for arms with goal probes, compare |rhat_at_trial - 1.0| vs |rhat_at_end - 1.0| (final-model re-evaluation of the goal-step obs) — does the reward head move toward 1.0 AND retain it in AUG+SEARCH? (ii) within-arm learning curve: p_goal episodes 7-14 vs 0-6 per arm. (iii) n_contexts trajectory per arm. (iv) per-seed correlation between goal-trial count and late-episode p_goal. All descriptive; no gates.
decision_rules.h_supported: BOTH interaction gates fire on the 6-seed aggregates: (a) interaction on p_goal: (p_AS - p_S) - (p_A - p_B) >= 0.15; AND (b) interaction on mean return: (ret_AS - ret_S) - (ret_A - ret_B) >= 0.5. Verdict: disambiguation helps ONLY once systematic search finds reward repeatedly (the mechanism lead is causally confirmed).
decision_rules.inconclusive: exactly one of (a)/(b) fires -> PARTIAL: reported honestly, no H verdict; mechanism follow-up required.
decision_rules.main_effects_descriptive: SEARCH main = mean(p_S, p_AS) - mean(p_B, p_A); AUG main = mean(p_A, p_AS) - mean(p_B, p_S); computed on p_goal and on mean return, with per-seed tables. No hard gates — descriptive.
decision_rules.manipulation_checks_descriptive: (i) coverage: distinct (key, action) pairs visited per (arm, seed) — expect SEARCH arms > BASE/AUG; (ii) p_goal_S vs p_goal_B — did the search intervention actually find more goals? (iii) mean applied bonus per tick vs mean |vhat| — is the bonus behaviorally meaningful or drowned? If (ii) fails, the interaction test is moot and reported as such.
decision_rules.null_holds: neither (a) nor (b) fires -> NULL HOLDS: no interaction — search helps or doesn't, independently of disambiguation (or neither helps). Recorded in research/negative_results.md; B's MATURITY.md annotated.
